login-passwd-override.name: login-passwd-override
login-passwd-override.help: Enable/disable overriding the admin administrator password for a managed FortiSwitch with the FortiGate admin administrator account password.

options.name: enable
options.help: Override a managed FortiSwitch's admin administrator password.

options.name: disable
options.help: Use the managed FortiSwitch admin administrator account password.

revision-backup-on-logout.name: revision-backup-on-logout
revision-backup-on-logout.help: Enable/disable automatic revision backup upon logout from FortiSwitch.

options.name: enable
options.help: Enable automatic revision backup upon logout from FortiSwitch.

options.name: disable
options.help: Disable automatic revision backup upon logout from FortiSwitch.

revision-backup-on-upgrade.name: revision-backup-on-upgrade
revision-backup-on-upgrade.help: Enable/disable automatic revision backup upon FortiSwitch image upgrade.

options.name: enable
options.help: Enable automatic revision backup upon FortiSwitch image upgrade.

options.name: disable
options.help: Disable automatic revision backup upon FortiSwitch image upgrade.
